issues.on_page: Transfers In 170,500 in Total Revenues 2,248,597 (p8); no transfers-out line among disbursements 2,015,389 (p9)
issues.issue: The governmental funds receive 170,500 in transfers (p5-7: General 28,981, Street 21,500, Culture and Recreation 120,019), and no governmental fund sends any. The total-primary-government budget schedule counts the 170,500 in revenues but has no transfers-out line, and its fund balances still roll (1,638,461 + 2,248,597 - 2,015,389 = 1,871,669). Its governmental disbursements (631,980) match the statement, so the matching outflow must sit inside the utility lines (Electric 939,349 / Solid Waste 124,906 / Sewer 189,881 / Water 129,273). That means 170,500 of transfers is recorded as business-type spending (disbursements[7]-[10]) while business_type.transfers_net is null. The page doesn't show which utility line holds it.
The trimmed pages never show where the 170,500 of transfers comes from. This is a one-sided transfer, and decision_needed[] has no entry for it (it is only mentioned in notes).

issues.on_page: Federal Receipts 150,651 vs governmental Grants 142,567; State Other 16,208 = Homestead 8,943 + Property Tax Credit 7,265
issues.issue: The derived business-type receipts include 8,084 of federal receipts (150,651 - 142,567), which can be split out as federal grants using the same page. The remaining 1,337,399 is the business share of 'Local Receipts: Other'. Since State Other is fully explained by homestead and property tax credit, the governmental 'Grants' line (receipts[11]) is all federal, so its review note ('may be partly state') doesn't hold.

issues.on_page: Schedule of Expenditures by fund column: General, Street, Culture and Recreation, Airport, Community Development, Community Center, Medical Center, Keno
issues.issue: Only the Total column was recorded, so every object line gets function 'other'. The fund columns (7 with activity) give the function split, which the department-column rule asks for. If the >6-fund combined rule is applied instead, the fund label should be 'Nonmajor funds (combined)'. Totals tie (608,480).
The rule says to record the budget schedule's utility fund lines (actual and budget) in detail. They appear only as statement-level disbursements, so their budget_final figures are not captured.

issues.on_page: Statement of Net Position p1: Governmental 2,981,904, Business-type 2,730,781, Total 5,712,685 (net position lines only, no assets printed)
issues.issue: The balance sheet covers governmental funds only. The government-wide Statement of Net Position prints no asset or liability lines, so business-type assets and liabilities are not captured. This is defensible because p1 has no asset lines.

issues.on_page: Proprietary fund statements (report pages between p26 and p51) not in trimmed PDF
issues.issue: This is a trimming gap: the business-type receipts, beginning cash and ending cash are derived from the combined budget schedule because the proprietary statements were not trimmed. Re-trim and re-extract.
